control_schema.label: Thinking
control_schema.description: Use Claude Code's installed adaptive-thinking control or disable extended thinking for this turn.

control_schema.label: Mode
control_schema.description: Claude Code's native permission mode. Some modes auto-permit or auto-deny actions before can_use_tool; those actions still receive post-tool audit evidence when the runtime exposes it.

availability.reason: Unavailable without a separate ruling from Live because it bypasses native permission checks.

control_schema.label: Settings sources
control_schema.description: Choose whether Claude Code inherits its native user, project, and local settings sources.

availability.reason: Requires a separate ruling from Live and disables native user, project, local settings and CLAUDE.md discovery.

execution_profiles.label: Inherit native settings
execution_profiles.description: Use the installed runtime settings. Native Ask requests that reach can_use_tool use Dialektike's governed relay; inherited auto-permit rules may bypass the callback and their exact source is not observable.

execution_profiles.label: Manual
execution_profiles.description: Ask through Claude Code's native default permission mode. Native rules that already match may still auto-permit and their exact source is not observable.

execution_profiles.label: Edit automatically
execution_profiles.description: Claude Code may accept supported edit operations without presenting a permission card; observable completed tools remain audited.

execution_profiles.label: Plan
execution_profiles.description: Claude Code explores and presents a plan under its native plan permission mode.

execution_profiles.label: Auto
execution_profiles.description: Claude Code applies its installed auto-mode classifier; actions it classifies as safe may not reach the permission callback.

execution_profiles.label: Don't ask
execution_profiles.description: Claude Code does not ask for permission; actions requiring approval are denied rather than promoted into a Dialektike card.

runtime_facilities.label: Output styles
runtime_facilities.description: Managed by the installed Claude Code runtime and not claimed as effective by Dialektike.

runtime_facilities.label: Permissions
runtime_facilities.description: Native Ask requests that reach can_use_tool use Dialektike's governed relay. Inherited allow rules, PreToolUse allows, and sandbox auto-allow may bypass that callback; observable completions remain audit-only and the effective external rule source is not observable.
